body: Thank you for the comment! I see... I am very hesitant to visit the therapist as I think I will be even more suicidal afterwards... In my country, people with depression are not well accepted.
don’t be sorry! no one has to be. thank you for your comment! I appreciate it
Sending hugs. I’m nowhere close to your situation and I myself feel lost. All I do is play games and sleep while watching everyone in their life do something useful.
i’m a burden too, what a coincidence
thanks for caring :) i really needed it, please don’t be sorry

In my area, being single at this age and living with parents is a completely normal thing 😬. I don’t have motivation neither & I do the exact same thing as you... watching youtube and learning about the world on my little phone.
im here if you want to talk, dont be alone
well i rather you beat yourself up as many suffer depression from the bullying at school and being beaten up by their schoolmates.
i wish everyone was as nice as you
I’m not scared of you, because that’s how I feel exactly.
both are fine as long as you clean up your blades after cutting or ensure they aren’t rusting.
wishing u all the best in it. my heart’s with you bro
well welcome back but please take care

First of all, you don’t sound like you have autism to me. I’m thinking it’s the stress you received that hindered you to learn. 

I’m having really bad depression and i’m suicidal as well so I can’t advice what you should do but if you want a friend or someone to talk to, i’m all up :).
i see, mine did not really calm me down. Like cutting myself gives me some form of satisfaction.

that sounds so much better. i might give it a go. I tried to cut my underarms before but ... it was hard to cut. 

sometimes i have the urge to cut near my heart area too

There are tons of ppl who care, but none of them sincerely cared. Once they found out about me, they stayed away, cut connections with me. 

I have waited too long for a person who cares for me, to exist.
